provider.description: The crash reporting service behind CrashReporterPort.

consentModel.description: opt-in: nothing is sent until the person turns crash reports on (the first-launch value of the saved choice is false). opt-out: the first-launch value is true and the settings toggle turns it off.

maxTracesSampleRate.description: The highest TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE (and PROFILES_SAMPLE_RATE) the code may use; 0 forbids tracing.

uploadProfiles.description: eas.json build profiles whose builds report, so they must upload source maps and native symbols.

declarations.description: What the store declarations say, in privacy-and-store-declarations' data-type ids (contracts/privacy.json sdks["@sentry/react-native"].collects lists the same types).
